753:t_125:1.en:
$$赤木$$
「Don't talk like it's over! We're still gonna fight!」

753:t_125:2.en:
$$いぶき$$
「$$ダイ・ガード$$ is built to fight $$ヘテロダイン$$s, after all.」

753:t_125:3.en:
$$青山$$
「If there are still $$界震$$s after we beat you, we'll head out again.」

753:t_125:4.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「I shall put an end to those days. That is the highest salvation.」

753:t_125:5.en:
$$赤木$$
「We don't need your good intentions forced on us like that!」

753:t_125:6.en:
$$赤木$$
「We'll live to the fullest on our own strength! Even if we're up against the universe, we'll fight desperately and keep living!」

753:t_125:7.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「You should know your place...」

753:t_125:8.en:
$$赤木$$
「I've heard enough of that! After coming this far, it doesn't matter if we're office workers or soldiers!」

753:t_125:9.en:
$$赤木$$
「Here we come, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$! We'll stop you, the enemy of every living being!」

753:t_125:10.en:
$$赤木$$
「I'll teach you, self-proclaimed God! Even office workers can protect peace... and the future!!」

753:t_126:0.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「I would like to demolish your childish argument for salvation, but unfortunately, there is no time.」

753:t_126:1.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「You disappoint me, $$ロジャー$$. Do you intend to abandon your profession?」

753:t_126:2.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「I am a professional. I take pride in my work.」

753:t_126:3.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「My commission was to negotiate with the world... In other words, to preserve the world where everyone lives.」

753:t_126:4.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「As a professional, I choose the best way to fulfill my commission... I have already judged that words cannot reach a self-righteous being like you.」

753:t_126:5.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Thus, by $$ロジャー$$'s law, I will stop you and save this universe from collapse!」

753:t_126:6.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「How sad. Your last memory will be regret at failing your commission.」

753:t_126:7.en:
$$ドロシー#bigo$$
「Will it? I cannot imagine $$ロジャー$$ failing.」

753:t_126:8.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Thank you, $$ドロシー#bigo$$. You do understand me, after all.」

753:t_126:9.en:
$$ドロシー#bigo$$
「That is my duty... No, my wish.」

753:t_126:10.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Then let's go, $$ドロシー#bigo$$! You, me and $$ビッグオー$$ will fulfill the commission!」

753:t_126:11.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「$$ビッグオー$$! Final Actioooon!!」

753:t_127:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「How sad, $$アポロ$$. You will lose your life to put the $$堕天翅$$s' regrets to rest.」

753:t_127:1.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Don't get the wrong idea, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$. I'm fighting because I can't forgive you.」

753:t_127:2.en:
$$シリウス$$
「Someone who gives up everything without facing hardship has no right to call himself God!」

753:t_127:3.en:
$$シルヴィア$$
「Someone who can calmly watch lives vanish before his eyes is our... no, every living being's enemy!」

753:t_127:4.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Humans and $$天翅$$s, men and women... They are fusing into one within the Mechanical Angel...!」

753:t_127:5.en:
$$アポロ$$
「And that will strike you down! To bring this universe a future!」

753:t_127:6.en:
$$アポロ$$
「I'll show you, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$! The wishes of every living being, gathered across the ages!」

753:t_127:7.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Now $$アクエリオン$$ will forge a path to the future! By breaking through the eternity you represent!!」

753:t_128:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「There is nothing to fear, $$アマタ$$. You and $$ミコノ$$ will be reborn in a new world and united there.」

753:t_128:2.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「I shall guide you in your next lives so it happens. So...」

753:t_128:4.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「What are you saying...」

753:t_128:5.en:
$$アマタ$$
「Who do you think you are?! Do you think I want a love someone else decided for me?!」

753:t_128:6.en:
$$アマタ$$
「Now I get it! You don't understand hearts, feelings or love at all!」

753:t_128:7.en:
$$アマタ$$
「That's why you can smile and accept it when you hear the universe is going to perish!」

753:t_128:8.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「That is not so. It is all because I have the resolve to become God.」

753:t_128:9.en:
$$アマタ$$
「Even if you really become God, I... we will never accept you!」

753:t_128:11.en:
$$アマタ$$
「Let's go, $$ミコノ$$! We'll defeat $$アドヴェント#pilot$$!」

753:t_128:12.en:
$$アマタ$$
「I can't give my future with $$ミコノ$$... the universe's future, to a guy who doesn't know what love meeeans!!」

753:t_129:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「$$カイエン$$... If you look into the future with your foresight, you should be willing to accept my salvation quietly.」

753:t_129:2.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Do you deny your own power?」

753:t_129:3.en:
$$カイエン$$
「I'll forge the future I want with my own hands!」

753:t_129:4.en:
$$カイエン$$
「I'll defeat you with these hands because you stand in its way! That's my fight!!」

753:t_130:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「$$ミコノ$$... In the new world, you will be united with your beloved $$アマタ$$. There is nothing to fear.」

753:t_130:1.en:
$$ミコノ$$
「I don't want another life! I want a future where I walk alongside $$アマタ$$!」

753:t_130:2.en:
$$ミコノ$$
「You stand in the way of that! You're the enemy of everyone who loves each other!」

753:t_130:3.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Anger does not suit you. An apostle of love should wear a sweet smile.」

753:t_130:4.en:
$$ミコノ$$
「Those selfish assumptions of yours rob other people of happiness!」

753:t_130:5.en:
$$ミコノ$$
「I'll fight someone like that...! I'm an $$エレメント$$ too!」

753:t_130:7.en:
$$ミコノ$$
「Lend me your strength, $$アマタ$$! To protect the world we love!」

753:t_130:8.en:
$$ミコノ$$
「$$アドヴェント#pilot$$! I'll fight you alongside $$アマタ$$!!」

753:t_131:0.en:
$$アンディ$$
「Let's do it! My digging power will settle this big showdown!」

753:t_131:1.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Your single-mindedness is endearing, $$アンディ$$.」

753:t_131:2.en:
$$アンディ$$
「I'm not into hearing that from a man! $$ＭＩＸ$$ is the only one I'd love even after she became a man!」

753:t_131:4.en:
$$アンディ$$
「I'm always dead serious! I'll risk my life to protect the world where we live together, $$ＭＩＸ$$!」

753:t_131:6.en:
$$アンディ$$
「Get ready, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$! I'll punch a huge hole in your precious Supreme God!!」

753:t_132:0.en:
$$モロイ$$
「The universe's fate rides on this fight! If that doesn't fire you up, you're no man!」

753:t_132:1.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「You have good fighting spirit, $$モロイ$$.」

753:t_132:2.en:
$$モロイ$$
「That's our self-proclaimed God. I'm touched that you even know someone as plain as me.」

753:t_132:3.en:
$$モロイ$$
「But I won't show mercy! For everyone who entrusted their hopes to us, we'll win this fight!!」

753:t_133:0.en:
$$カグラ$$
「Looks like you're not lying when you say you'll save the universe.」

753:t_133:1.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「You sniffed out the truth by instinct. Impressive, $$カグラ$$.」

753:t_133:2.en:
$$カグラ$$
「But I won't accept your methods!」

753:t_133:3.en:
$$カグラ$$
「That smile of yours...! That smile that says you think we're no better than bugs pisses me off!」

753:t_133:4.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「You are a stray dog after all... But your howling cannot reach me...!」

753:t_133:5.en:
$$カグラ$$
「Then I'll sink my teeth into your throat! Get ready, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$!!」

753:t_134:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「$$ジン$$ of $$アルテア$$... You survived beyond causality. I advise you to meet your final moment in peace.」

753:t_134:1.en:
$$ジン$$
「I've lived this long because I wanted to live for $$ユノハ$$!」

753:t_134:3.en:
$$ジン$$
「So I'll fight until the very end! Whether I'm up against fate or God!」

753:t_134:4.en:
$$ジン$$
「Lend me your strength, $$ユノハ$$! So we can overcome $$アドヴェント#pilot$$ and seize our future!!」

753:t_135:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「$$ゼシカ$$... Though you lost in love, you could find a different love in the new world.」
